# Section A — AP & GP basics

## Question 1 **[3]**

::: {.callout-note collapse="true" appearance="simple" icon=false}
## Answer
**First term $1$, common difference $4$.** &nbsp; **(M1 A1 A1)**

*Two terms give two equations.* $a+4d=17$ and $a+11d=45$ **(M1)**. Subtracting: $7d=28\Rightarrow d=4$ **(A1)**,
then $a=17-16=1$ **(A1)**.
:::

## Question 2 **[3]**

::: {.callout-note collapse="true" appearance="simple" icon=false}
## Answer
**$r=\dfrac14$.** &nbsp; **(M1 A1 A1)**

*Use $S_\infty=\dfrac{a}{1-r}$.* $\dfrac{18}{1-r}=24$ **(M1)** $\Rightarrow 1-r=\dfrac{18}{24}=\dfrac34$ **(A1)**,
so $r=\dfrac14$ (and $|r|<1$, so it converges) **(A1)**.
:::

## Question 3 **[3]**

::: {.callout-note collapse="true" appearance="simple" icon=false}
## Answer
**$1010$.** &nbsp; **(M1 A1 A1)**

$S_{20}=\dfrac{20}{2}\bigl(2a+19d\bigr)=10(6+95)$ **(M1 A1)** $=10\cdot101=1010$ **(A1)**.
:::

## Question 4 **[3]**

::: {.callout-note collapse="true" appearance="simple" icon=false}
## Answer
**$765$.** &nbsp; **(M1 A1 A1)**

*Divide the two term equations to get $r$.* $ar^2=12,\ ar^5=96\Rightarrow r^3=8\Rightarrow r=2$, then $a=3$
**(M1 A1)**. $S_8=\dfrac{3(2^8-1)}{2-1}=3\cdot255=765$ **(A1)**.
:::

# Section B — Sum to infinity & recurrences

## Question 5 **[4]**

::: {.callout-note collapse="true" appearance="simple" icon=false}
## Answer
**$27$.** &nbsp; **(M1 A1 A1 A1)**

$ar=6$ and $ar^3=\dfrac23$, so $r^2=\dfrac{2/3}{6}=\dfrac19$ **(M1)**. *Positive terms ⇒ $r=\dfrac13$* **(A1)**,
then $a=\dfrac{6}{r}=18$ **(A1)**. Since $|r|<1$, $S_\infty=\dfrac{18}{1-\frac13}=27$ **(A1)**.
:::

## Question 6 **[4]**

::: {.callout-note collapse="true" appearance="simple" icon=false}
## Answer
**$u_n=3^{n}+2$; $u_6=731$.** &nbsp; **(M1 A1 A1 A1)**

*Find the fixed point $L=3L-4\Rightarrow L=2$, then $u_n-2$ is geometric:* $u_{n+1}-2=3(u_n-2)$ **(M1 A1)**.
With $u_1-2=3$, $u_n-2=3\cdot3^{n-1}=3^{n}$, so $u_n=3^{n}+2$ **(A1)**. Hence $u_6=3^6+2=731$ **(A1)**.
*(Or just iterate: $5,11,29,83,245,731$.)*
:::

# Section C — Binomial

## Question 7 **[3]**

::: {.callout-note collapse="true" appearance="simple" icon=false}
## Answer
**$-560$.** &nbsp; **(M1 A1 A1)**

*The $x^3$ term is $\dbinom{7}{3}(2)^{4}(-x)^{3}$* **(M1)** $=35\cdot16\cdot(-1)\,x^3$ **(A1)** $=-560x^3$, so the
coefficient is $-560$ **(A1)**.
:::

## Question 8 **[3]**

::: {.callout-note collapse="true" appearance="simple" icon=false}
## Answer
**$160$.** &nbsp; **(M1 A1 A1)**

*General term $\dbinom{6}{k}(2x)^{6-k}\left(\dfrac1x\right)^{k}=\dbinom{6}{k}2^{6-k}x^{6-2k}$; the constant
needs $6-2k=0\Rightarrow k=3$* **(M1 A1)**. Constant $=\dbinom{6}{3}2^{3}=20\cdot8=160$ **(A1)**.
:::

## Question 9 **[4]**

::: {.callout-note collapse="true" appearance="simple" icon=false}
## Answer
**$30$.** &nbsp; **(M1 A1 A1 A1)**

*Collect $x^2$ from both ways it can appear.* In $(1-2x)^5$: the $x^2$ coefficient is
$\dbinom{5}{2}(-2)^2=40$ and the $x^1$ coefficient is $\dbinom{5}{1}(-2)=-10$ **(M1 A1)**. Multiplying by
$(1+x)$: the $x^2$ term is $1\cdot40+x\cdot(-10x)$, i.e. $40+(-10)=30$ **(A1 A1)**.
:::

## Question 10 **[3]**

::: {.callout-note collapse="true" appearance="simple" icon=false}
## Answer
**$n=4$.** &nbsp; **(M1 A1 A1)**

*The coefficient of $x$ in $(1+3x)^n$ is $\dbinom{n}{1}\cdot3=3n$* **(M1)**. Set $3n=12$ **(A1)** $\Rightarrow
n=4$ **(A1)**.
:::

# Section D — Harder

## Question 11 **[4]**

::: {.callout-note collapse="true" appearance="simple" icon=false}
## Answer
**$43$.** &nbsp; **(M1 A1 A1 A1)**

*Use $a_n=S_n-S_{n-1}$.* $a_n=(n^2+4n)-\bigl((n-1)^2+4(n-1)\bigr)$ **(M1)** $=2n+3$ **(A1 A1)**. So $a_{20}=43$
**(A1)**.
:::

## Question 12 **[4]**

::: {.callout-note collapse="true" appearance="simple" icon=false}
## Answer
**$r=\dfrac45$ or $r=-\dfrac45$.** &nbsp; **(M1 A1 A1 A1)**

Let the GP have first term $a$: $a(1+r)=9$ and $\dfrac{a}{1-r}=25\Rightarrow a=25(1-r)$ **(M1)**. Substitute:
$25(1-r)(1+r)=9\Rightarrow25(1-r^2)=9$ **(A1)** $\Rightarrow 1-r^2=\dfrac{9}{25}\Rightarrow r^2=\dfrac{16}{25}$
**(A1)**. So $r=\pm\dfrac45$, and both satisfy $|r|<1$ (so both are valid) **(A1)**.
:::
